svg.text: you can end any of these
Near-field on every one of them, whatever your dial says
there are other people in all four places, so the channel stays narrow
Sam has lent the profiles a microphone
on a smart watch · keys on their voice
you, speaking close to the microphone
a disclosure only the lender can see is not a disclosure
It hears them, not the room
near-field, and it keys on its wearer — both, not either
a permission must not outlive the conversation
a conference puck would lend the voices of people who did not agree
